metadata.title: Fixed geodesics of involutions on $3$-spheres
metadata.abstract: Let an isometric involution act on a smooth Riemannian $3$-sphere with sectional curvature at least one. We prove that every one-dimensional connected component of its fixed-point set has length at most $2\pi$, and that the bound is sharp. The proof realizes the fixed circle as the link of a complete totally geodesic surface in a positively curved expanding Ricci soliton and applies Bishop--Gromov comparison to its area growth. The analytic input is an equivariant version of Deruelle's smoothing of positively curved cones. We use Gianniotis--Schulze's equivariant local deformation and explain a marked compactness argument for arbitrary finite isotropy. In particular, the end chart retains the specified group action, rather than only an unspecified conjugate.

analysis.workSummary: 研究截面曲率至少为一的黎曼三维球面上等距对合的不动测地线长度。
techniques: 等变 Ricci 扩张孤立子平滑
analysis.breakthrough: 证明不动点集的一维连通分支长度至多 2π，且该界可达到；通过锥的等变平滑将问题转为面积增长比较。
analysis.limitations: 需要光滑黎曼三维球面、截面曲率下界与等距对合；等变平滑保留指定群作用是关键分析输入。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露 ChatGPT 用于探索计算、可能的证明方向和文字润色，但未明确归因任何核心引理或已采用的关键路线。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29796v1 · PDF 第 17 页 Use of generative AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确披露 ChatGPT 用于探索计算、可能的证明方向和文字润色，但未明确归因任何核心引理或已采用的关键路线。

analysis.priorityReason: 将低维固定点几何与 Ricci 流平滑技术相连的尖锐结果。
